title: Pension and investment scams: how they work and what to do if you've been contacted

posts.facebook:
A pension cold call is illegal in the UK. That single fact stops most pension scams before they start.

The two main pension scams, the warning signs the FCA and FTC list, how to check a firm on the official registers, and step-by-step what to do if you've been contacted or have already paid, in the UK and the US. General information, not financial advice.

Hang up on unexpected contact, check the firm on the official register yourself, and if you've already paid, act within hours, not days.

Read the full story → https://dontdieretired.com/money/pension-and-investment-scams-after-50/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=daily
